scripts.build: npm run typecheck && cross-env WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext build
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --import ./tests/cloudflare-workers-stub.mjs --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.typegen: cross-env WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler --config wrangler.jsonc types worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.typegen:check: cross-env WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler --config wrangler.jsonc types worker-configuration.d.ts --check
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run db:check && npm test
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply a-fine-wall-db --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:built: npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npm run deploy:cloudflare:built
